title: Erdős lower bound for the diagonal Ramsey number
statement:
For an integer $k \ge 1$, let $r(k,k)$ denote the Ramsey number: the least $n$ such that every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique of size $k$ or an independent set of size $k$. Then
\[
2^{k/2} \le r(k,k).
\]
hypotheses_covered: k is a natural number with 1 ≤ k
